title: The Memorandum — Dusek
description: Colonel Dusek requested a meeting through Brenner's aide — not through regular channels. She arrived in civilian clothes. Grey jacket. Imprecise fit. She carries a folder she hasn't opened yet. When Dusek breaks protocol, something has already broken.

title: The Finance Minister's Statement — Vostane
description: Vostane is on television. Kolvar is standing beside her. She is reading from prepared remarks. The word 'resignation' hasn't been said yet, but it's in the next paragraph. The markets are watching.

title: The Folder on the Desk — Vyktor
description: Vyktor is at your desk. 7:43pm. A folder faces you — not his usual briefing book. He has been speaking with the constitutional opposition. He wants you to hear it from him before you hear it from them.

title: Budget Allocation — Trust Deficit
description: Someone in your inner circle is about to leave — or has already left in everything but the press release. Review the budget before whoever it is can use the numbers against you.

title: Dravenhollow — Situation Assessment
description: The Dravenni deputies are requesting an urgent meeting. The border situation has deteriorated. Whatever is happening in the mountains, it's about to become a crisis that demands your attention.

title: Liora — Her Mother's Daughter
description: Liora arrived at your office without an appointment. She has an early draft of Nadia's reporting — not the final version, the one Nadia showed her sources. Your daughter knows things about your government that your cabinet doesn't.

title: The Line at the Gate
description: Four Kravenstal collieries have gone silent on the same morning — coordinated, not spontaneous. Stefan Morvec arrives in person, unannounced, offering to end it by Thursday.
